question: A 3-year-old boy was brought in by his parents for undescended testes. The physical examination showed an absence of the left testis in the scrotum. Inguinal swelling was noted on the left side and was surgically corrected. Which of the following conditions will most likely occur in the later stages of his life?
analysis: The condition described in the scenario is cryptorchidism, where one or both testes fail to descend into the scrotum. Surgical correction is typically done to bring the undescended testis into the scrotum. Individuals with a history of cryptorchidism are at an increased risk for developing testicular cancer later in life.
